name: Paper-Cut Red
tagline: crawfordxx/paper-cut-video-skill: Chinese red paper-cut tutorial — vermilion on warm paper, layered cut-out pieces, a red seal on the outro. (Songti → DM Serif Display, Heiti → Archivo Black.)

motion.direction: paper-cut-video visual system. Warm paper stage, vermilion (`ter`) and dark red (`goldd`) paper pieces with a light keyline, ochre tape. Layers from back to front: background, rear pieces, supports, the hero, foreground, captions; the hero enters first, the rest stagger 0.2–0.4 s with a short spring (1–4° rotation correction, damped scale settle). The background pushes at most ~1 %; idle motion under 6 px. Headlines serif (DM Serif Display) 60–96 px; captions one phrase per cue on a dark rounded plate in the bottom rail. Hold each finished frame ~0.5 s to read. Close with a red seal `stamp` over the last 3–5 s.
